email.subject: Sleep timer, subtitles and a broken remote
email.body:
Hello,

I have two questions about my Smart Tech TV. Can the TV switch itself off after an hour when I fall asleep? And how do I turn on subtitles?

Also, the remote stopped working after a fall last week. Can I get a replacement under warranty? My order number is SO-448812.

Best regards,
Anna Schmidt
anna.schmidt@example.com
